manifest.name: dsh-paperforge
manifest.description: PaperForge — forge your understanding of papers inside DSH: selection-to-highlight, selection-to-ask (one dedicated session per paper), marquee-to-note screenshots with backlinks.

bundle.text:
# 本包的 bundle 补丁层（package.json 的 dsh.bundle.patch 指向这里）。
# `dsh plugin --profile web add …` 安装后，DSH 会把下面这一行自动组合进 profile，
# 无需手改任何 YAML。要改配置，在 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 里按 id 覆盖（见 README「配置」），
# 不要再写 `- insert:`，否则会插入第二个同 id 的行。
- insert:
    - id: paperforge
      name: "dsh-paperforge"

readme.text:
在 DSH 里读论文：边读、边问、边记

快速开始 · 亮点 · TODO · 开发手册 · English

[](./LICENSE) [](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) [](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [](https://github.com/PhysicalAI-0/dsh-paperforge)
**读懂一篇论文，留下自己的思考。** 从论文库点开 PDF，原文、专属 AI 会话与 Markdown 笔记并排展开：选中难懂的段落，带着上下文向 AI 追问；划下重要的文字，框选值得留存的图表，高亮与截图自动收进本地笔记。下次打开，接着上次的思考往下读。

- **2026-09-29** - 原生多栏阅读布局：左边会话列表，中间本篇论文的 AI 会话，右边 PDF｜笔记。 - 新增会话 Summary 与复制路径；笔记目录改为 `paperforge_notes`，不再引用的图片自动清理。 - Markdown 块级编辑：所有 `.md` 都能原地编辑、自动保存。 - 阅读链路重做：论文库、笔记实时预览、每篇论文一个专属 AI 会话。 - **2026-09-28** — 首个版本发布；改为 DSH 原生 `dsh plugin` 安装。

readme.section: 亮点
readme.text:
论文库
左侧栏「论文」列出工作区里的 PDF，点一篇进入阅读布局		 标注
划词高亮（六色）与框选截图自动写进笔记；选段也可复制为原文或 Markdown 引用		 Ask AI
划词「Ask AI」或页头「AI」：问题带上 @论文、页码与选段，发进本篇论文的会话
Markdown 编辑
所有 .md 都能原地编辑：点一块改源码，离开即渲染；自动保存，与插件、AI 的改动自动合并		 Summary
论文库「会话」页签勾选会话，生成一份 Summary（Markdown）：每 3 个一批引用，最后综合		 复制路径
任意文档页头的复制图标，一键复制文件路径

readme.section: 亮点
readme.text:
笔记：点一块改源码，其余保持渲染
Summary：勾选的会话由 AI 汇总成一份 Markdown
截图中的论文页面来自 Vaswani et al., Attention Is All You Need（arXiv:1706.03762），按 Google 的授权注明出处、用于学术用途。Logo 与章节图标由 AI 图像模型生成。

readme.section: 亮点
快速开始
readme.text:
前置条件：DSH `0.1.7+`，PATH 上有 `pnpm`。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:PhysicalAI-0/dsh-paperforge

readme.section: 或克隆后本地安装（改代码后重启 dsh web 即生效）：
readme.text: git clone https://github.com/PhysicalAI-0/dsh-paperforge.git && cd dsh-paperforge dsh plugin --profile web add . ``` 在放论文的目录启动 `dsh web`（这个目录也要是 DSH 的工作区），左侧栏出现「论文」即安装成功。卸载：`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-paperforge`。

readme.section: 笔记放在哪
readme.text: ```text <论文目录>/paperforge_notes/ ├─ <论文名>/<论文名>.md 笔记（标准 Markdown，可直接编辑） ├─ <论文名>/assets/ 截图；不再被任何笔记引用的图片约 2 分钟后自动删除 ├─ <论文名>/highlights.json、session.json 高亮位置、与论文会话的绑定

readme.section: 配置（可选）
readme.text: 在 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 里按 id 覆盖： ```yaml - id: paperforge config: workspaceRoot: <论文目录的绝对路径> # 缺省 = 启动 dsh web 的目录 notesDir: paperforge_notes # 笔记根目录名（旧版默认是 notes） 不要写 `- insert:`（插件会被加载两次）。配置了 `model` 时，DSH 也会把它存为新会话的默认模型。

- [ ] Markdown 即时渲染（类似 Vditor）：图片点击放大、块拖拽排序 - [ ] 富渲染：mermaid 流程图 / 时序图 / 甘特图、echarts 图表、脑图 - [ ] 为同一篇论文开多个会话（页头「AI」按钮） - [ ] 按页、按图读论文的工具与读图 skill，降低读图的 token 消耗 - [ ] 问答要点自动写回笔记 - [ ] 统一为 JavaScript：用 `mupdf` 替换 Python 边车；论文库扫描改为异步

readme.section: 已知限制
readme.text: - 右侧栏最多两栏（DSH 限制），更多窗口请拖成浮动。 - 论文会话在第一次提问前，左侧列表显示为「新会话」，DSH 的「新建会话」可能复用它。 - Markdown 按块编辑：撤销只在当前块内；跨块的引用式链接与脚注可能不生效；工作区外或超过 2 MB 的 `.md` 只能预览。 - Summary：DSH 每条消息最多引用 3 个会话，插件分批发送；内容由 AI 用写文件工具写入。 - 不同目录下的同名 PDF 共用一个笔记文件夹；笔记里的章节名固定为中文。

readme.section: 开发
readme.text: ```bash pixi run test # 单元测试 pixi run verify # 契约与冒烟测试 ``` 插件分两半：浏览器半 `lib/client.js`，宿主半 `lib/index.js` 等（注册 `/api/paper.*` 路由）。另有可选的 Python 边车 `py/`，只用于把高亮写进 PDF 文件本身。开发前先读 [`AGENTS.md`](./AGENTS.md)：DSH 插件的硬约束、关键 API、踩过的坑和路线图都在里面。

readme.section: 缘起与致谢
readme.text: 作者是 [alphaXiv](https://www.alphaxiv.org/) 的重度用户，本插件「划词即问、就地记笔记」的交互正是受它启发。但它的问答额度有限，模型也不能替换，于是把「划词 → 追问 → 落笔记」搬回自己掌控的 DSH：不重复造阅读器，复用 DSH 原生的预览、会话与模型配置。 PaperForge 与 alphaXiv 及其团队无任何隶属、赞助或背书关系，也不包含其任何代码或素材。

Read papers in DSH: read, ask and take notes in one place

Quick start · Highlights · TODO · Developer handbook · 简体中文
[](./LICENSE) [](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) [](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [](https://github.com/PhysicalAI-0/dsh-paperforge)

**Understand the paper. Keep your own thinking.** Open a PDF from the paper library to bring the paper, its dedicated AI session and your Markdown notes side by side. Select a difficult passage to ask AI with the context included; highlight key text or capture a figure, and your highlights and screenshots go straight into local notes. Come back to the paper and pick up where your thinking left off.

- **2026-09-29**
  - Native multi-column reading layout: session list on the left, the paper's AI session in the middle, PDF｜notes on the right.
  - Added session Summary and Copy path; notes now live in `paperforge_notes`, and images no longer referenced by any note are cleaned up.
  - Block-level Markdown editing: every `.md` is editable in place, with autosave.
  - Reading flow rebuilt: paper library, live notes preview, one dedicated AI session per paper.
- **2026-09-28** — First release; installs through DSH's native `dsh plugin` command.

Paper library
Papers in the left sidebar lists the PDFs in your workspace; pick one to open the reading layout		 Annotate
Highlights (six colours) and region screenshots are saved to your notes automatically; selections can also be copied as plain text or Markdown quotes		 Ask AI
Ask AI on a selection or AI in the PDF header opens the paper's session; questions about a selection include @paper, the page number and the passage
Markdown editing
Every .md is editable in place: click a block to edit its source, leave to render it; autosaves and merges with changes from the plugin or the AI		 Summary
Tick sessions on the library's Sessions tab to produce one Summary in Markdown: referenced three at a time, then combined		 Copy path
The copy icon in any document header copies the file's path in one click

Notes: click any block to edit its source
Summary: the AI combines the ticked sessions into one Markdown file

Paper pages in the screenshots are from Vaswani et al., Attention Is All You Need (arXiv:1706.03762), reproduced with attribution for scholarly use as Google permits. The logo and section icons were generated with an AI image model.

readme.section: Quick start
readme.text:
Requirements: DSH `0.1.7+` and `pnpm` on your PATH.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:PhysicalAI-0/dsh-paperforge

readme.section: or install from a local clone (code changes take effect after restarting dsh web):
readme.text: git clone https://github.com/PhysicalAI-0/dsh-paperforge.git && cd dsh-paperforge dsh plugin --profile web add . ``` Start `dsh web` in the folder that holds your papers (that folder must also be a DSH workspace). A **Papers** entry in the left sidebar means it's installed. Uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-paperforge`.

readme.section: Where notes go
readme.text: ```text /paperforge_notes/ ├─ /.md notes (standard Markdown, editable in place) ├─ /assets/ captures; images not referenced by any note are removed after about 2 minutes ├─ /highlights.json, session.json highlight positions, link to the paper's session

Override by id in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: paperforge config: workspaceRoot: # defaults to the folder dsh web starts in notesDir: paperforge_notes # notes root folder (older versions used notes) Don't use `- insert:` (the plugin would load twice). When `model` is set, DSH also saves it as the default model for new sessions.

- [ ] Instant-rendering Markdown (Vditor-style): click an image to zoom, drag blocks to reorder
- [ ] Rich rendering: mermaid flowcharts / sequence diagrams / Gantt charts, echarts, mind maps
- [ ] Several sessions for the same paper (the **AI** header button)
- [ ] Tools and a skill for reading papers by page and by figure, cutting the token cost of reading figures
- [ ] Write key Q&A points back into the notes automatically
- [ ] Pure JavaScript: replace the Python sidecar with `mupdf`; make the library scan asynchronous

readme.section: Known limitations
readme.text:
- The right sidebar has at most two panes (a DSH limit); float extra windows out.
- Before its first question, a paper session shows as "New session" in the left list, and DSH's "New session" may reuse it.
- Markdown is edited block by block: undo covers only the current block; reference-style links and footnotes defined in another block may not resolve; a `.md` outside the workspaces or over 2 MB is preview-only.
- Summary: DSH references at most three sessions per message, so the plugin sends batches; the AI writes the result with its file-writing tool.
- PDFs with the same file name in different folders share one notes folder; section headings in the notes are always Chinese.

readme.section: Known limitations

readme.text:
```bash
pixi run test     # unit tests
pixi run verify   # contract and smoke tests
```

The plugin has two halves: the browser half `lib/client.js` and the host half `lib/index.js` and friends (registering the `/api/paper.*` routes), plus an optional Python sidecar `py/` used only to write highlights into the PDF file itself. Read [`AGENTS.md`](./AGENTS.md) (in Chinese) before developing: it covers the hard constraints on DSH plugins, the key APIs, the pitfalls hit so far and the roadmap.

readme.section: Background and acknowledgement
readme.text: The author is a heavy user of [alphaXiv](https://www.alphaxiv.org/), which inspired this plugin's "ask about a selection, take notes in place" interaction. Its Q&A allowance is limited and its model can't be swapped, so this brings the "select → ask → note" loop into DSH, an environment you fully control: no new reader, just DSH's native preview, sessions and model configuration.
